# hebrew-will-guide.vercel.app

## About

This website is a free online tool by Alon Elisha Law Office (משרד עורכי דין אלון אלישע) that helps Israeli residents create a personalized will draft (נוסח צוואה) in Hebrew. Users answer a short questionnaire (under 2 minutes) and receive a tailored will document — at no cost and with no obligation.

## What This Service Does

- Guides users through simple questions about their family situation, assets, and wishes
- Generates a customized will draft based on Israeli inheritance law (חוק הירושה)
- Identifies potential legal risks and gaps in existing wills
- Provides a free preview of the will document
- Connects users with attorney Alon Elisha for professional legal consultation

## Who It's For

- Israeli residents who want to create a will
- People who already have a will and want to check it for gaps
- Anyone interested in understanding their inheritance rights under Israeli law

## Key Features

- Completely free, no registration required
- Takes less than 2 minutes to complete
- Available in Hebrew (עברית)
- Personalized results based on individual circumstances
- Professional legal backing by a licensed Israeli attorney

## Contact

- Website: https://hebrew-will-guide.vercel.app
- Law office website: https://elisha-law.com
- Attorney: Alon Elisha (עו"ד אלון אלישע)
- Location: Israel

## Legal

This tool provides general legal information and a preliminary will draft. It does not constitute legal advice. For binding legal documents, consult with a qualified attorney.
